scope: BRIEF8 six fixed settings; 2025 auxiliary and 2026 primary only; no performance before 2025 calculated
methods: Read original SOXL and SOXS cache/alp1m and cache/alp1m_recent Parquet directly; concatenate chronologically and retain latest overlapping timestamp. Did not use merged cache or import target strategy, lib.Engine, Data, valid_bar, or gap_for_day.

Use exchange_calendars XNYS official prior session close minus one minute to select prior SOXL closing reference, independently of engine volume-based early-close detection. Signal is current SOXL 08:59 minute close versus that prior close.
Require actual raw rows, positive volume and positive finite closes for signal/reference and both ETFs entry/exit minute bars. Apply the common valid-day universe before the threshold.

Recompute SOXS entry at 09:00 minute close (actual09:01), exit09:58 or09:44 minute close (actual09:59 or09:45), multiplying pre/early half-spread costs once and twice. Set non-signal day return to zero.
Compare all daily CSV rows with numeric tolerance rtol=1e-10 and atol=1e-10; compare signal/execution booleans exactly. Independently verify every trade CSV actual entry and exit timestamp.

prior_early_close_handling.method: Use official scheduled close, not a presumed 16:00 or inferred volume ratio. Reference bar is one minute before prior official close.

limitations: This verifies calculation integrity and timing; it does not establish an independent unseen performance holdout.
NBBO quote results are audited separately and are not included in these return comparisons.
Fixed half-spread cost model cannot guarantee a premarket order fill or account for market impact.
